scripts.voice: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip edge-tts mutagen && .venv/bin/python scripts/generate_voice.py

scripts.common-cold:render: npm run common-cold:voice && remotion render src/index.ts CommonCold out/common-cold.mp4
